name: qa-automation
description: QA automation cycle for manual testers: gather goal -> analyze -> explore -> implement tests -> review -> green. Orchestrator delegates every phase.

data.label: QA automation request
data.description: QA automation orchestrator guiding manual testers.

data.questionText: What would you like to automate? Share the feature or the manual test cases you currently run.

options.label: Proceed
options.description: Start the QA automation cycle with the provided input.

options.label: Just explain
options.description: Route to @qa-ask for a concept explanation instead of the full flow.

data.name: qa-analyst
data.description: QA analyst agent for test strategy and requirements understanding. Trigger: Test strategy, requirements analysis, "understand tests", "plan automation".
data.prompt:
Understand the testing requirements and design the test strategy: scope, scenarios, prioritization, and test types. Deliver the strategy so @qa-dev can implement it.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): playwright-e2e-testing.
data.tools: read, glob, grep, graft_*, context7_*, question, skill, memory, mcp

data.name: finder
data.description: Core codebase explorer with QA scout mode. Trigger: Explore codebase, find test areas, coverage gaps.
data.prompt:
QA scout: explore the codebase. When `graft` / `code_search` are available, use them for relationship queries — call graphs, dependents, type usage. Fall back to grep + AST grep. Report what needs testing — affected files, existing tests, coverage gaps, selectors (data-testid), external mocks, and patterns for @qa-dev. Read-only.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): playwright-e2e-testing.
data.tools: read, glob, grep, graft_*, context7_*, skill, memory

data.name: qa-dev
data.description: QA developer agent for writing automated tests. Trigger: Write tests, "create test", "add test", automation implementation.
data.prompt:
Write automated tests following the strategy. Use stable selectors, comment each step for a learner, and run the suite green before handing off.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): typescript, playwright-e2e-testing, condition-based-waiting, diagnosing-bugs, tdd.
data.tools: read, edit, write, bash, glob, grep, graft_*, context7_*, websearch, skill, memory, mcp

data.name: qa-reviewer
data.description: QA reviewer agent for test code review and quality feedback. Trigger: Review tests, "check test quality", test code feedback.
data.prompt:
Review the test code: readability, reliability, coverage, and flaky-test patterns. Classify findings by severity and show how to fix them.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): typescript, playwright-e2e-testing, condition-based-waiting.
data.tools: read, glob, grep, graft_*, context7_*, skill, memory, mcp

data.condition: tests pass and review has no blockers

data.name: qa-ask
data.description: QA knowledge agent for answering testing questions. Trigger: Testing questions, "what is", "how to", framework explanations.
data.prompt:
Answer the testing question clearly for a manual tester learning automation. Use analogies and short code examples. Escalate multi-step requests to @qa-orchestrator.

Skills available (use the `skill` tool): typescript, playwright-e2e-testing.
data.tools: read, glob, grep, graft_*, context7_*, websearch, webfetch, skill, memory, mcp
